svg.title: Document ingestion pipeline
svg.desc: An uploaded file is parsed locally by Docling into Markdown, tables and figures, PII-masked by Presidio, split into typed nodes, embedded with Gemini and persisted to a LlamaIndex vector store.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Ingestion pipeline: from raw file to a searchable, PII-safe index

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Steps 1 to 5 run on your machine; only PII-masked text is sent to Gemini for embedding
